title: Built 500 hp Dodge Challenger Doing Burnouts
description: We recently shot a sick C10 featuring a Hellcat motor with our friend Jody who introduced us to his friend Brad and his badass 1973 Dodge Challenger. We knew as soon as we saw this car we had to shoot it. That purple with gold wheels is beautiful and the sounds are glorious so here it is. Sit back and enjoy the ride...
